SELECT
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) AS owner_name,
  n.nspacl IS NULL AS acl_uses_hardwired_default
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS type_schema,
  t.typname AS type_name,
  t.typtype AS type_kind,
  t.typcategory AS type_category,
  t.typisdefined AS is_defined,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner) AS owner_name,
  CASE WHEN t.typbasetype = 0 THEN NULL ELSE pg_catalog.format_type(t.typbasetype, t.typtypmod) END AS domain_base_type,
  t.typnotnull AS domain_not_null,
  t.typdefault AS type_default,
  CASE WHEN t.typelem = 0 THEN NULL ELSE pg_catalog.format_type(t.typelem, NULL) END AS element_type,
  rn.nspname AS related_relation_schema,
  rc.relname AS related_relation_name,
  rc.relkind AS related_relation_kind,
  cn.nspname AS collation_schema,
  col.collname AS collation_name,
  t.typlen AS internal_length,
  t.typbyval AS passed_by_value,
  t.typalign AS alignment,
  t.typstorage AS storage
FROM pg_catalog.pg_type AS t
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS rc ON rc.oid = t.typrelid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS rn ON rn.oid = rc.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_collation AS col ON col.oid = t.typcollation
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS cn ON cn.oid = col.collnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname, t.typname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS type_schema,
  t.typname AS type_name,
  e.enumsortorder AS sort_order,
  e.enumlabel AS enum_label
FROM pg_catalog.pg_enum AS e
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname, t.typname, e.enumsortorder

SELECT
  n.nspname AS domain_schema,
  t.typname AS domain_name,
  c.conname AS constraint_name,
  c.convalidated AS validated,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid, false) AS constraint_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS t ON t.oid = c.contypid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
WHERE c.contypid <> 0
  AND n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname, t.typname, c.conname

SELECT
  rn.nspname AS range_schema,
  rt.typname AS range_name,
  mrn.nspname AS multirange_schema,
  mrt.typname AS multirange_name,
  sn.nspname AS subtype_schema,
  st.typname AS subtype_name,
  cn.nspname AS collation_schema,
  coll.collname AS collation_name,
  onsp.nspname AS operator_class_schema,
  opc.opcname AS operator_class_name,
  can_n.nspname AS canonical_function_schema,
  can_p.proname AS canonical_function_name,
  CASE WHEN can_p.oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(can_p.oid) END AS canonical_function_identity_arguments,
  diff_n.nspname AS subtype_diff_function_schema,
  diff_p.proname AS subtype_diff_function_name,
  CASE WHEN diff_p.oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(diff_p.oid) END AS subtype_diff_function_identity_arguments
FROM pg_catalog.pg_range AS r
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS rt ON rt.oid = r.rngtypid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS rn ON rn.oid = rt.typnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS mrt ON mrt.oid = r.rngmultitypid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS mrn ON mrn.oid = mrt.typnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS st ON st.oid = r.rngsubtype
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS sn ON sn.oid = st.typnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_collation AS coll ON coll.oid = r.rngcollation
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS cn ON cn.oid = coll.collnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_opclass AS opc ON opc.oid = r.rngsubopc
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS onsp ON onsp.oid = opc.opcnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS can_p ON can_p.oid = r.rngcanonical
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS can_n ON can_n.oid = can_p.pronamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS diff_p ON diff_p.oid = r.rngsubdiff
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS diff_n ON diff_n.oid = diff_p.pronamespace
WHERE rn.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY rn.nspname, rt.typname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  c.relkind AS relation_kind,
  c.relpersistence AS persistence,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,
  c.relispartition AS is_partition,
  c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled,
  c.relforcerowsecurity AS force_rls,
  c.relreplident AS replica_identity,
  c.relhasrules AS has_rules,
  c.reloptions AS relation_options,
  pt.partstrat AS partition_strategy,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_partkeydef(c.oid) AS partition_key,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound, c.oid, false) AS partition_bound,
  pn.nspname AS parent_schema,
  pc.relname AS parent_table,
  dn.nspname AS default_partition_schema,
  dc.relname AS default_partition_name
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_partitioned_table AS pt ON pt.partrelid = c.oid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS dc ON dc.oid = pt.partdefid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS dn ON dn.oid = dc.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_inherits AS i ON i.inhrelid = c.oid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS pc ON pc.oid = i.inhparent
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS pn ON pn.oid = pc.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
  AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'f')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, pn.nspname NULLS FIRST, pc.relname NULLS FIRST

SELECT
  n.nspname AS relation_schema,
  c.relname AS relation_name,
  c.relkind AS relation_kind,
  a.attnum AS ordinal_position,
  a.attname AS column_name,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS formatted_type,
  a.attndims AS array_dimensions,
  a.attnotnull AS not_null,
  a.atthasdef AS has_default_or_generation,
  a.attidentity AS identity_kind,
  a.attgenerated AS generated_kind,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, false) AS default_or_generation_expression,
  cn.nspname AS collation_schema,
  col.collname AS collation_name,
  a.attislocal AS locally_defined,
  a.attinhcount AS inheritance_count,
  a.attstorage AS storage_strategy,
  a.attcompression AS compression_method,
  a.attoptions AS column_options,
  a.attacl IS NOT NULL AS column_acl_present
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = a.attrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef AS d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_collation AS col ON col.oid = a.attcollation
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS cn ON cn.oid = col.collnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
  AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'f', 'v', 'm', 'c')
  AND a.attnum > 0
  AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, a.attnum

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  cn.nspname AS constraint_schema,
  con.conname AS constraint_name,
  con.contype AS constraint_kind,
  con.condeferrable AS deferrable,
  con.condeferred AS initially_deferred,
  con.convalidated AS validated,
  con.conislocal AS locally_defined,
  con.coninhcount AS inheritance_count,
  con.connoinherit AS no_inherit,
  rn.nspname AS referenced_table_schema,
  rc.relname AS referenced_table_name,
  con.confupdtype AS foreign_key_update_action,
  con.confdeltype AS foreign_key_delete_action,
  con.confmatchtype AS foreign_key_match_type,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid, false) AS constraint_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS con
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS cn ON cn.oid = con.connamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS rc ON rc.oid = con.confrelid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS rn ON rn.oid = rc.relnamespace
WHERE con.conrelid <> 0
  AND con.contype IN ('p', 'u', 'c', 'x', 'f')
  AND n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, con.conname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  con.conname AS constraint_name,
  k.key_ordinal AS key_ordinal,
  a.attname AS column_name,
  rn.nspname AS referenced_table_schema,
  rc.relname AS referenced_table_name,
  ra.attname AS referenced_column_name,
  CASE WHEN con.confdelsetcols IS NULL THEN false ELSE k.attnum = ANY(con.confdelsetcols) END AS delete_set_column
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS con
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, key_ordinal)
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS rc ON rc.oid = con.confrelid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS rn ON rn.oid = rc.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS ra ON ra.attrelid = con.confrelid AND ra.attnum = con.confkey[k.key_ordinal]
WHERE con.conrelid <> 0
  AND con.contype IN ('p', 'u', 'c', 'x', 'f')
  AND n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, con.conname, k.key_ordinal

SELECT
  tn.nspname AS table_schema,
  tc.relname AS table_name,
  ins.nspname AS index_schema,
  ic.relname AS index_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(ic.relowner) AS owner_name,
  am.amname AS access_method,
  i.indnatts AS total_attributes,
  i.indnkeyatts AS key_attributes,
  i.indisunique AS is_unique,
  i.indnullsnotdistinct AS nulls_not_distinct,
  i.indisprimary AS is_primary,
  i.indisexclusion AS is_exclusion,
  i.indimmediate AS immediate,
  i.indisclustered AS clustered,
  i.indisvalid AS valid,
  i.indisready AS ready,
  i.indislive AS live,
  i.indisreplident AS replica_identity,
  ic.reloptions AS index_options,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, 0, false) AS index_definition,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indexprs, i.indrelid, false) AS index_expressions,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indpred, i.indrelid, false) AS index_predicate
FROM pg_catalog.pg_index AS i
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS ins ON ins.oid = ic.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS tc ON tc.oid = i.indrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS tn ON tn.oid = tc.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am AS am ON am.oid = ic.relam
WHERE tn.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY tn.nspname, tc.relname, ins.nspname, ic.relname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS sequence_schema,
  c.relname AS sequence_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,
  c.relpersistence AS persistence,
  pg_catalog.format_type(s.seqtypid, NULL) AS data_type,
  s.seqstart AS start_value,
  s.seqincrement AS increment_by,
  s.seqmin AS minimum_value,
  s.seqmax AS maximum_value,
  s.seqcache AS cache_size,
  s.seqcycle AS cycles,
  tn.nspname AS owned_table_schema,
  tc.relname AS owned_table_name,
  a.attname AS owned_column_name,
  d.deptype AS ownership_dependency_kind
FROM pg_catalog.pg_sequence AS s
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = s.seqrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_depend AS d
  ON d.classid = c.tableoid
  AND d.objid = c.oid
  AND d.objsubid = 0
  AND d.deptype IN ('a', 'i')
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS tc ON tc.oid = d.refobjid AND d.refclassid = tc.tableoid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS tn ON tn.oid = tc.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid = tc.oid AND a.attnum = d.refobjsubid
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, tn.nspname NULLS FIRST, tc.relname NULLS FIRST, a.attname NULLS FIRST

SELECT
  n.nspname AS view_schema,
  c.relname AS view_name,
  c.relkind AS relation_kind,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,
  c.relpersistence AS persistence,
  c.relispopulated AS materialized_view_populated,
  c.reloptions AS relation_options,
  pg_catalog.octet_length(pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, false)) AS definition_bytes,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, false) AS view_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
  AND c.relkind IN ('v', 'm')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS routine_schema,
  p.proname AS routine_name,
  p.prokind AS routine_kind,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) AS full_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS return_clause,
  l.lanname AS language_name,
  p.provolatile AS volatility,
  p.proparallel AS parallel_mode,
  p.prosecdef AS security_definer,
  p.proleakproof AS leakproof,
  p.proisstrict AS strict,
  p.proretset AS returns_set,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner_name,
  pg_catalog.octet_length(pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition_bytes,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS routine_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language AS l ON l.oid = p.prolang
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
  AND p.prokind IN ('f', 'p', 'w')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend AS d
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_extension AS e ON e.oid = d.refobjid
    WHERE d.classid = p.tableoid
      AND d.objid = p.oid
      AND d.refclassid = e.tableoid
      AND d.deptype = 'e'
  )
ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname, pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)

SELECT
  n.nspname AS routine_schema,
  p.proname AS routine_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner_name
FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
  AND p.prokind = 'a'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend AS d
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_extension AS e ON e.oid = d.refobjid
    WHERE d.classid = p.tableoid
      AND d.objid = p.oid
      AND d.refclassid = e.tableoid
      AND d.deptype = 'e'
  )
ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname, pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)

SELECT
  n.nspname AS relation_schema,
  c.relname AS relation_name,
  t.tgname AS trigger_name,
  t.tgtype AS trigger_type_mask,
  t.tgenabled AS enabled_mode,
  t.tgdeferrable AS deferrable,
  t.tginitdeferred AS initially_deferred,
  t.tgnargs AS argument_count,
  t.tgoldtable AS old_transition_table,
  t.tgnewtable AS new_transition_table,
  fn.nspname AS function_schema,
  p.proname AS function_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS function_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(t.tgqual, t.tgrelid, false) AS when_expression,
  pg_catalog.octet_length(pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid, false)) AS definition_bytes,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid, false) AS trigger_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS t
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p ON p.oid = t.tgfoid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS fn ON fn.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal
  AND n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, t.tgname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  p.polname AS policy_name,
  p.polpermissive AS permissive,
  p.polcmd AS command_code,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid, false) AS using_expression,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid, false) AS with_check_expression
FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = p.polrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, p.polname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  p.polname AS policy_name,
  roles.role_ordinal AS role_ordinal,
  CASE WHEN roles.role_oid = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(roles.role_oid) END AS role_name
FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = p.polrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.unnest(p.polroles) WITH ORDINALITY AS roles(role_oid, role_ordinal)
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, p.polname, roles.role_ordinal

SELECT
  'schema' AS object_kind,
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  n.nspname AS object_name,
  NULL AS routine_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) AS owner_name,
  n.nspacl IS NULL AS explicit_acl_was_null,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) AS grantor_name,
  CASE WHEN acl.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END AS grantee_name,
  acl.privilege_type AS privilege_type,
  acl.is_grantable AS is_grantable
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(n.nspacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('n', n.nspowner))) AS acl
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname, acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  'relation' AS object_kind,
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  c.relname AS object_name,
  NULL AS routine_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,
  c.relacl IS NULL AS explicit_acl_was_null,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) AS grantor_name,
  CASE WHEN acl.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END AS grantee_name,
  acl.privilege_type AS privilege_type,
  acl.is_grantable AS is_grantable
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('r', c.relowner))) AS acl
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
  AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  'sequence' AS object_kind,
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  c.relname AS object_name,
  NULL AS routine_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,
  c.relacl IS NULL AS explicit_acl_was_null,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) AS grantor_name,
  CASE WHEN acl.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END AS grantee_name,
  acl.privilege_type AS privilege_type,
  acl.is_grantable AS is_grantable
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('s', c.relowner))) AS acl
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
  AND c.relkind = 'S'
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  'routine' AS object_kind,
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  p.proname AS object_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS routine_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner_name,
  p.proacl IS NULL AS explicit_acl_was_null,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) AS grantor_name,
  CASE WHEN acl.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END AS grantee_name,
  acl.privilege_type AS privilege_type,
  acl.is_grantable AS is_grantable
FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('f', p.proowner))) AS acl
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
  AND p.prokind IN ('f', 'p', 'w')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend AS d
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_extension AS e ON e.oid = d.refobjid
    WHERE d.classid = p.tableoid
      AND d.objid = p.oid
      AND d.refclassid = e.tableoid
      AND d.deptype = 'e'
  )
ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname, pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid), acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  'default_acl' AS object_kind,
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  d.defaclobjtype AS object_name,
  NULL AS routine_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) AS owner_name,
  false AS explicit_acl_was_null,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) AS grantor_name,
  CASE WHEN acl.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END AS grantee_name,
  acl.privilege_type AS privilege_type,
  acl.is_grantable AS is_grantable
FROM pg_catalog.pg_default_acl AS d
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = d.defaclnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(d.defaclacl) AS acl
WHERE d.defaclnamespace = 0 OR n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public', 'supabase_migrations')
ORDER BY n.nspname NULLS FIRST, d.defaclrole, d.defaclobjtype, acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) AS owner_name,
  n.nspacl IS NULL AS acl_uses_hardwired_default
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname

SELECT 'schema' AS object_class, n.nspname AS object_schema, n.nspname AS object_name, NULL::text AS object_kind, n.nspname AS object_identity
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'relation', n.nspname, c.relname, c.relkind::text, n.nspname || '.' || c.relname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'type', n.nspname, t.typname, t.typtype::text, n.nspname || '.' || t.typname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_type AS t
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'routine', n.nspname, p.proname, p.prokind::text, n.nspname || '.' || p.proname || '(' || pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) || ')'
FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'constraint', n.nspname, c.conname, c.contype::text, n.nspname || '.' || c.conname || ' ON ' || CASE WHEN c.conrelid <> 0 THEN rn.nspname || '.' || rc.relname WHEN c.contypid <> 0 THEN tn.nspname || '.' || t.typname ELSE n.nspname END
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.connamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS rc ON rc.oid = c.conrelid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS rn ON rn.oid = rc.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS t ON t.oid = c.contypid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS tn ON tn.oid = t.typnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'collation', n.nspname, c.collname, c.collencoding::text, n.nspname || '.' || c.collname || ' ENCODING ' || c.collencoding::text
FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.collnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'conversion', n.nspname, c.conname, NULL::text, n.nspname || '.' || c.conname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_conversion AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.connamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'operator', n.nspname, o.oprname, o.oprkind::text, n.nspname || '.' || o.oprname || '(' || pg_catalog.format_type(o.oprleft, NULL) || ',' || pg_catalog.format_type(o.oprright, NULL) || ')'
FROM pg_catalog.pg_operator AS o
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = o.oprnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'operator_class', n.nspname, o.opcname, am.amname::text, n.nspname || '.' || o.opcname || ' USING ' || am.amname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_opclass AS o
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = o.opcnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am AS am ON am.oid = o.opcmethod
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'operator_family', n.nspname, o.opfname, am.amname::text, n.nspname || '.' || o.opfname || ' USING ' || am.amname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_opfamily AS o
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = o.opfnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am AS am ON am.oid = o.opfmethod
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'text_search_parser', n.nspname, o.prsname, NULL::text, n.nspname || '.' || o.prsname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_parser AS o
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = o.prsnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'text_search_dictionary', n.nspname, o.dictname, NULL::text, n.nspname || '.' || o.dictname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_dict AS o
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = o.dictnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'text_search_template', n.nspname, o.tmplname, NULL::text, n.nspname || '.' || o.tmplname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_template AS o
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = o.tmplnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'text_search_configuration', n.nspname, o.cfgname, NULL::text, n.nspname || '.' || o.cfgname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_config AS o
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = o.cfgnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'extended_statistics', n.nspname, o.stxname, NULL::text, n.nspname || '.' || o.stxname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_statistic_ext AS o
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = o.stxnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'policy', n.nspname, p.polname, p.polcmd::text, n.nspname || '.' || c.relname || '.' || p.polname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = p.polrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'trigger', n.nspname, t.tgname, t.tgenabled::text, n.nspname || '.' || c.relname || '.' || t.tgname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS t
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private' AND NOT t.tgisinternal
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rewrite_rule', n.nspname, r.rulename, r.ev_type::text, n.nspname || '.' || c.relname || '.' || r.rulename
FROM pg_catalog.pg_rewrite AS r
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = r.ev_class
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'private'
ORDER BY object_class, object_schema, object_name, object_kind, object_identity

SELECT
  e.extname AS extension_name,
  e.extversion AS installed_version,
  n.nspname AS extension_schema,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner) AS owner_name,
  e.extrelocatable AS relocatable,
  pg_catalog.cardinality(e.extconfig) AS configuration_table_count
FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension AS e
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = e.extnamespace
ORDER BY e.extname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS type_schema,
  t.typname AS type_name,
  t.typtype AS type_kind,
  t.typcategory AS type_category,
  t.typisdefined AS is_defined,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner) AS owner_name,
  t.typacl IS NULL AS type_acl_uses_hardwired_default,
  CASE WHEN t.typbasetype = 0 THEN NULL ELSE pg_catalog.format_type(t.typbasetype, t.typtypmod) END AS domain_base_type,
  t.typnotnull AS domain_not_null,
  t.typdefault AS type_default,
  CASE WHEN t.typelem = 0 THEN NULL ELSE pg_catalog.format_type(t.typelem, NULL) END AS element_type,
  rn.nspname AS related_relation_schema,
  rc.relname AS related_relation_name,
  rc.relkind AS related_relation_kind,
  cn.nspname AS collation_schema,
  col.collname AS collation_name,
  t.typlen AS internal_length,
  t.typbyval AS passed_by_value,
  t.typalign AS alignment,
  t.typstorage AS storage
FROM pg_catalog.pg_type AS t
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS rc ON rc.oid = t.typrelid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS rn ON rn.oid = rc.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_collation AS col ON col.oid = t.typcollation
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS cn ON cn.oid = col.collnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname, t.typname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS type_schema,
  t.typname AS type_name,
  e.enumsortorder AS sort_order,
  e.enumlabel AS enum_label
FROM pg_catalog.pg_enum AS e
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname, t.typname, e.enumsortorder

SELECT
  n.nspname AS domain_schema,
  t.typname AS domain_name,
  c.conname AS constraint_name,
  c.convalidated AS validated,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid, false) AS constraint_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS t ON t.oid = c.contypid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
WHERE c.contypid <> 0
  AND n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname, t.typname, c.conname

SELECT
  rn.nspname AS range_schema,
  rt.typname AS range_name,
  mrn.nspname AS multirange_schema,
  mrt.typname AS multirange_name,
  sn.nspname AS subtype_schema,
  st.typname AS subtype_name,
  cn.nspname AS collation_schema,
  coll.collname AS collation_name,
  onsp.nspname AS operator_class_schema,
  opc.opcname AS operator_class_name,
  can_n.nspname AS canonical_function_schema,
  can_p.proname AS canonical_function_name,
  CASE WHEN can_p.oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(can_p.oid) END AS canonical_function_identity_arguments,
  diff_n.nspname AS subtype_diff_function_schema,
  diff_p.proname AS subtype_diff_function_name,
  CASE WHEN diff_p.oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(diff_p.oid) END AS subtype_diff_function_identity_arguments
FROM pg_catalog.pg_range AS r
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS rt ON rt.oid = r.rngtypid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS rn ON rn.oid = rt.typnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS mrt ON mrt.oid = r.rngmultitypid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS mrn ON mrn.oid = mrt.typnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS st ON st.oid = r.rngsubtype
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS sn ON sn.oid = st.typnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_collation AS coll ON coll.oid = r.rngcollation
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS cn ON cn.oid = coll.collnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_opclass AS opc ON opc.oid = r.rngsubopc
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS onsp ON onsp.oid = opc.opcnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS can_p ON can_p.oid = r.rngcanonical
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS can_n ON can_n.oid = can_p.pronamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS diff_p ON diff_p.oid = r.rngsubdiff
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS diff_n ON diff_n.oid = diff_p.pronamespace
WHERE rn.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY rn.nspname, rt.typname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS type_schema,
  t.typname AS type_name,
  t.typtype AS type_kind,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner) AS owner_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) AS grantor_name,
  CASE WHEN acl.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END AS grantee_name,
  acl.privilege_type AS privilege_type,
  acl.is_grantable AS is_grantable
FROM pg_catalog.pg_type AS t
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(t.typacl) AS acl
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
  AND t.typacl IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY n.nspname, t.typname, acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  c.relkind AS relation_kind,
  c.relpersistence AS persistence,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,
  c.relispartition AS is_partition,
  c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled,
  c.relforcerowsecurity AS force_rls,
  c.relreplident AS replica_identity,
  c.relhasrules AS has_rules,
  c.reloptions AS relation_options,
  pt.partstrat AS partition_strategy,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_partkeydef(c.oid) AS partition_key,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound, c.oid, false) AS partition_bound,
  pn.nspname AS parent_schema,
  pc.relname AS parent_table,
  dn.nspname AS default_partition_schema,
  dc.relname AS default_partition_name
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_partitioned_table AS pt ON pt.partrelid = c.oid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS dc ON dc.oid = pt.partdefid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS dn ON dn.oid = dc.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_inherits AS i ON i.inhrelid = c.oid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS pc ON pc.oid = i.inhparent
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS pn ON pn.oid = pc.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
  AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'f')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, pn.nspname NULLS FIRST, pc.relname NULLS FIRST

SELECT
  n.nspname AS relation_schema,
  c.relname AS relation_name,
  c.relkind AS relation_kind,
  a.attnum AS ordinal_position,
  a.attname AS column_name,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS formatted_type,
  a.attndims AS array_dimensions,
  a.attnotnull AS not_null,
  a.atthasdef AS has_default_or_generation,
  a.attidentity AS identity_kind,
  a.attgenerated AS generated_kind,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, false) AS default_or_generation_expression,
  cn.nspname AS collation_schema,
  col.collname AS collation_name,
  a.attislocal AS locally_defined,
  a.attinhcount AS inheritance_count,
  a.attstorage AS storage_strategy,
  a.attcompression AS compression_method,
  a.attoptions AS column_options,
  a.attacl IS NOT NULL AS column_acl_present
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = a.attrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef AS d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_collation AS col ON col.oid = a.attcollation
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS cn ON cn.oid = col.collnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
  AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'f', 'v', 'm', 'c')
  AND a.attnum > 0
  AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, a.attnum

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  cn.nspname AS constraint_schema,
  con.conname AS constraint_name,
  con.contype AS constraint_kind,
  con.condeferrable AS deferrable,
  con.condeferred AS initially_deferred,
  con.convalidated AS validated,
  con.conislocal AS locally_defined,
  con.coninhcount AS inheritance_count,
  con.connoinherit AS no_inherit,
  rn.nspname AS referenced_table_schema,
  rc.relname AS referenced_table_name,
  con.confupdtype AS foreign_key_update_action,
  con.confdeltype AS foreign_key_delete_action,
  con.confmatchtype AS foreign_key_match_type,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid, false) AS constraint_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS con
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS cn ON cn.oid = con.connamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS rc ON rc.oid = con.confrelid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS rn ON rn.oid = rc.relnamespace
WHERE con.conrelid <> 0
  AND con.contype IN ('p', 'u', 'c', 'x', 'f')
  AND n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, con.conname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  con.conname AS constraint_name,
  k.key_ordinal AS key_ordinal,
  a.attname AS column_name,
  rn.nspname AS referenced_table_schema,
  rc.relname AS referenced_table_name,
  ra.attname AS referenced_column_name,
  CASE WHEN con.confdelsetcols IS NULL THEN false ELSE k.attnum = ANY(con.confdelsetcols) END AS delete_set_column
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS con
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, key_ordinal)
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS rc ON rc.oid = con.confrelid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS rn ON rn.oid = rc.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS ra ON ra.attrelid = con.confrelid AND ra.attnum = con.confkey[k.key_ordinal]
WHERE con.conrelid <> 0
  AND con.contype IN ('p', 'u', 'c', 'x', 'f')
  AND n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, con.conname, k.key_ordinal

SELECT
  tn.nspname AS table_schema,
  tc.relname AS table_name,
  ins.nspname AS index_schema,
  ic.relname AS index_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(ic.relowner) AS owner_name,
  am.amname AS access_method,
  i.indnatts AS total_attributes,
  i.indnkeyatts AS key_attributes,
  i.indisunique AS is_unique,
  i.indnullsnotdistinct AS nulls_not_distinct,
  i.indisprimary AS is_primary,
  i.indisexclusion AS is_exclusion,
  i.indimmediate AS immediate,
  i.indisclustered AS clustered,
  i.indisvalid AS valid,
  i.indisready AS ready,
  i.indislive AS live,
  i.indisreplident AS replica_identity,
  ic.reloptions AS index_options,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, 0, false) AS index_definition,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indexprs, i.indrelid, false) AS index_expressions,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indpred, i.indrelid, false) AS index_predicate
FROM pg_catalog.pg_index AS i
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS ins ON ins.oid = ic.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS tc ON tc.oid = i.indrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS tn ON tn.oid = tc.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am AS am ON am.oid = ic.relam
WHERE tn.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY tn.nspname, tc.relname, ins.nspname, ic.relname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS sequence_schema,
  c.relname AS sequence_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,
  c.relpersistence AS persistence,
  pg_catalog.format_type(s.seqtypid, NULL) AS data_type,
  s.seqstart AS start_value,
  s.seqincrement AS increment_by,
  s.seqmin AS minimum_value,
  s.seqmax AS maximum_value,
  s.seqcache AS cache_size,
  s.seqcycle AS cycles,
  tn.nspname AS owned_table_schema,
  tc.relname AS owned_table_name,
  a.attname AS owned_column_name,
  d.deptype AS ownership_dependency_kind
FROM pg_catalog.pg_sequence AS s
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = s.seqrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_depend AS d
  ON d.classid = c.tableoid
  AND d.objid = c.oid
  AND d.objsubid = 0
  AND d.deptype IN ('a', 'i')
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS tc ON tc.oid = d.refobjid AND d.refclassid = tc.tableoid
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS tn ON tn.oid = tc.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid = tc.oid AND a.attnum = d.refobjsubid
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, tn.nspname NULLS FIRST, tc.relname NULLS FIRST, a.attname NULLS FIRST

SELECT
  n.nspname AS view_schema,
  c.relname AS view_name,
  c.relkind AS relation_kind,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,
  c.relpersistence AS persistence,
  c.relispopulated AS materialized_view_populated,
  c.reloptions AS relation_options,
  pg_catalog.octet_length(pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, false)) AS definition_bytes,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, false) AS view_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
  AND c.relkind IN ('v', 'm')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS relation_schema,
  c.relname AS relation_name,
  r.rulename AS rule_name,
  r.ev_type AS event_type,
  r.ev_enabled AS enabled_mode,
  r.is_instead AS is_instead,
  pg_catalog.octet_length(pg_catalog.pg_get_ruledef(r.oid, false)) AS definition_bytes,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_ruledef(r.oid, false) AS rule_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_rewrite AS r
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = r.ev_class
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, r.rulename

SELECT
  n.nspname AS routine_schema,
  p.proname AS routine_name,

FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  p.polname AS policy_name,
  roles.role_ordinal AS role_ordinal,
  CASE WHEN roles.role_oid = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(roles.role_oid) END AS role_name
FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = p.polrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.unnest(p.polroles) WITH ORDINALITY AS roles(role_oid, role_ordinal)
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, p.polname, roles.role_ordinal

SELECT
  'schema' AS object_kind,
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  n.nspname AS object_name,
  NULL AS routine_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) AS owner_name,
  n.nspacl IS NULL AS explicit_acl_was_null,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) AS grantor_name,
  CASE WHEN acl.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END AS grantee_name,
  acl.privilege_type AS privilege_type,
  acl.is_grantable AS is_grantable
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(n.nspacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('n', n.nspowner))) AS acl
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname, acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  'relation' AS object_kind,
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  c.relname AS object_name,
  NULL AS routine_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,

FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('r', c.relowner))) AS acl
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
  AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f')
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  'sequence' AS object_kind,

  c.relname AS object_name,

  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner_name,

ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  'routine' AS object_kind,
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  p.proname AS object_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS routine_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner_name,

SELECT
  'default_acl' AS object_kind,
  n.nspname AS schema_name,
  d.defaclobjtype AS object_name,
  NULL AS routine_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) AS owner_name,

  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) AS grantor_name,

FROM pg_catalog.pg_default_acl AS d
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = d.defaclnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(d.defaclacl) AS acl
WHERE d.defaclnamespace = 0 OR n.nspname IN ('private')
ORDER BY n.nspname NULLS FIRST, d.defaclrole, d.defaclobjtype, acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  'column' AS object_kind,

  CASE WHEN acl.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END AS grantee_name,

FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = a.attrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(a.attacl) AS acl
WHERE n.nspname IN ('private')
  AND a.attnum > 0
  AND NOT a.attisdropped
  AND a.attacl IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, a.attnum, acl.grantor, acl.grantee, acl.privilege_type, acl.is_grantable

SELECT
  dc.relname AS dependent_class_catalog,
  d.objid AS dependent_object_oid,
  d.objsubid AS dependent_subobject_id,
  dep.type_name AS dependent_type,
  dep.schema_name AS dependent_schema,
  dep.object_name AS dependent_name,
  dep.identity AS dependent_identity,
  rc.relname AS referenced_class_catalog,
  d.refobjid AS referenced_object_oid,
  d.refobjsubid AS referenced_subobject_id,
  ref.type_name AS referenced_type,
  ref.schema_name AS referenced_schema,
  ref.object_name AS referenced_name,
  ref.identity AS referenced_identity,
  d.deptype AS dependency_kind
FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend AS d
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS dc ON dc.oid = d.classid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS rc ON rc.oid = d.refclassid
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.pg_identify_object(d.classid, d.objid, d.objsubid) AS dep(type_name, schema_name, object_name, identity)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.pg_identify_object(d.refclassid, d.refobjid, d.refobjsubid) AS ref(type_name, schema_name, object_name, identity)
WHERE dep.schema_name = 'private'
   OR ref.schema_name = 'private'
   OR (dep.type_name = 'schema' AND dep.identity = 'private')
   OR (ref.type_name = 'schema' AND ref.identity = 'private')
ORDER BY dc.relname, d.objid, d.objsubid, rc.relname, d.refobjid, d.refobjsubid, d.deptype

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  p.polname AS policy_name,
  p.polpermissive AS permissive,
  p.polcmd AS command_code,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid, false) AS using_expression,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid, false) AS with_check_expression
FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = p.polrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
  AND (
    POSITION('private.' IN COALESCE(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid, false), '')) > 0
    OR POSITION('private.' IN COALESCE(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid, false), '')) > 0
  )
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, p.polname

  n.nspname AS table_schema,

JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = p.polrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.unnest(p.polroles) WITH ORDINALITY AS roles(role_oid, role_ordinal)
WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
  AND (
    POSITION('private.' IN COALESCE(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid, false), '')) > 0
    OR POSITION('private.' IN COALESCE(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid, false), '')) > 0

ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, p.polname, roles.role_ordinal

SELECT
  n.nspname AS routine_schema,
  p.proname AS routine_name,
  p.prokind AS routine_kind,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) AS full_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS return_clause,
  l.lanname AS language_name,
  p.provolatile AS volatility,
  p.proparallel AS parallel_mode,
  p.prosecdef AS security_definer,
  p.proleakproof AS leakproof,
  p.proisstrict AS strict,
  p.proretset AS returns_set,
  p.proconfig AS configuration,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner_name,
  pg_catalog.octet_length(pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition_bytes,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS routine_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language AS l ON l.oid = p.prolang
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public')
  AND p.prokind IN ('f', 'p', 'w')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend AS d
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_extension AS e ON e.oid = d.refobjid
    WHERE d.classid = p.tableoid
      AND d.objid = p.oid
      AND d.refclassid = e.tableoid
      AND d.deptype = 'e'
  )
ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname, pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)

SELECT
  n.nspname AS view_schema,

  c.relpersistence AS persistence,

  c.reloptions AS relation_options,
  pg_catalog.octet_length(pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, false)) AS definition_bytes,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, false) AS view_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public')
  AND c.relkind IN ('v', 'm')
  AND POSITION('private.' IN pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, false)) > 0
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS relation_schema,
  c.relname AS relation_name,
  t.tgname AS trigger_name,
  t.tgtype AS trigger_type_mask,
  t.tgenabled AS enabled_mode,
  fn.nspname AS function_schema,
  p.proname AS function_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS function_identity_arguments,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(t.tgqual, t.tgrelid, false) AS when_expression,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid, false) AS trigger_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS t
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p ON p.oid = t.tgfoid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS fn ON fn.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal
  AND n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public')
  AND (
    fn.nspname = 'private'
    OR POSITION('private.' IN COALESCE(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(t.tgqual, t.tgrelid, false), '')) > 0
    OR POSITION('private.' IN pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid, false)) > 0
  )
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, t.tgname

SELECT
  n.nspname AS relation_schema,
  c.relname AS relation_name,
  a.attname AS column_name,
  a.attidentity AS identity_kind,
  a.attgenerated AS generated_kind,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, false) AS default_or_generation_expression
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = a.attrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef AS d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum
WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public')
  AND a.attnum > 0
  AND NOT a.attisdropped
  AND POSITION('private.' IN pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, false)) > 0
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, a.attnum

SELECT
  n.nspname AS table_schema,
  c.relname AS table_name,
  con.conname AS constraint_name,
  con.contype AS constraint_kind,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid, false) AS constraint_definition
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS con
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE con.conrelid <> 0
  AND n.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public')
  AND POSITION('private.' IN pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid, false)) > 0
ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, con.conname

SELECT
  tn.nspname AS table_schema,
  tc.relname AS table_name,
  ins.nspname AS index_schema,
  ic.relname AS index_name,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, 0, false) AS index_definition,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indexprs, i.indrelid, false) AS index_expressions,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indpred, i.indrelid, false) AS index_predicate
FROM pg_catalog.pg_index AS i
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS ins ON ins.oid = ic.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS tc ON tc.oid = i.indrelid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS tn ON tn.oid = tc.relnamespace
WHERE tn.nspname IN ('public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions', 'graphql_public')
  AND (
    POSITION('private.' IN pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, 0, false)) > 0
    OR POSITION('private.' IN COALESCE(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indexprs, i.indrelid, false), '')) > 0
    OR POSITION('private.' IN COALESCE(pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indpred, i.indrelid, false), '')) > 0
  )
ORDER BY tn.nspname, tc.relname, ins.nspname, ic.relname
